rationale: The described suite provides analytics, reports, attribution, data export, and marketing-tag deployment. These are conventional analytics and tag-management functions, but the implementation of 'Data Driven Attribution' is unspecified, leaving a possible AI interpretation; non-AI is forced.
evidence_spans: Analytics 360, Attribution 360, Audience Center 360, Optimize 360, and Tag Manager 360.
Google Tag Manager allows you to manage and deploy marketing tags (snippets of code or tracking pixels) on your website (or mobile app) without having to modify the code.
